introduction: Explore ruined Nital, the battle for the valley and the temple rift. Nine exact deliveries remain independent, including foreign trophies and the blood-to-rings-to-necklace route. Active, ready accounting is required; personal recovery, access, prisoner state and full campaigns need additional accepted evidence.
orientation: Enter from the surface lava fields and descend to the shield. The mostly formed golem carries its sharp shard key. The battle and ruined village lead toward the gnoll caves and temple. Discovery or holding a key does not prove successful unlocking, safe passage or a completed quest.

The mature white dragon carries the temple key. The black wyrm carries the inner-sanctum key, the many-armed demon carries the vault key, and the demonic advisor carries the final chest key. The blood sits inside the locked, pickproof chest in the vault office. These are separate doors and a separate container; keys are optional route guidance when matching blood is supplied.

The advisor also accepts three independent deliveries: the captive sack, three exact heads, and the bodyguard essence. Killing this carried-key holder can remove the recipient until replacement. Choose a source/recipient episode deliberately; a prior receipt cannot restore a missing character.

Return the heirloom ring from the hazardous demonic pit to Nital's survivor for Tallin's signet. The same pit has the strip of young demon hide. Ground declarations do not prove a personal kill or skinning event, and the ring is not one of the colored rings of perfection.

The frost giant upstairs in the ruined home carries the hefty wiggling sack. Examine the two strange columns downstairs for the legs clue. The sack delivery represents a captive in prose, without an escorted NPC or separate capture state.

Bring the exact local commander head plus Grog's Fields Between head and Zuzon's former dwarven lord head from Torg to the demonic advisor together. Only the tunnel commander carries the accepted head; the other same-named commander carries godly magic. The native recipe is narrower than the clue suggesting either commander.

Tallin's bodyguard has a holding source that leads into Mount Banishment and carries the essence for the advisor. Returning it narrates plans to bring the bodyguard back without actually resummoning him. Foreign encounters and recovery remain distinct from the accepted Scorched Valley delivery.

The collector on the overlook accepts two distinct standards plus the pit hide for one object named two bubbles of blazing energy. His separate dragon-charm request uses the abandoned souvenir cart's contents for a scarf. The flaming demon blocks ordinary players' up command while present. Membership and the battle's outcome are narrative rather than extra checked objectives.

Return godly magic from the other commander to the nervous council advisor in Torg. His holding source leads into that council hallway. The exchange stays owned by Scorched Valley and leaves the recipient present despite the runs-off text; it does not execute the planned curse.

Bring Tallin's blood to the seeker in the Fields Between raider camp for four distinct colored rings. Then offer those four rings together to the wandering wildmage for a necklace. Each delivery has its own outcome; the earlier receipt is optional producer history and cannot replace worn, nested, missing or spent proof.

Enter the dimensional rift from Tallin's chamber to the Abyss; its counterpart returns. The full rod object has lore but no verified active assembly terminal or declared reset source. Tallin, the Queen and Miska do not define an extra battle finale. The worn fog wisp responds to say invisible on a cooldown as an item effect, separate from delivery credit.

Yeenoghu's authored healing and attacks currently reject the server's combat event and are not scheduled periodically. A separate repair must qualify dispatch, callback survival and balance before restoring that behavior. Holding exits and reset caps require live encounter qualification; rare-room prose is not a declared rare reset percentage.

contacts.name: the mostly formed golem
contacts.description: Outside the shield. Carries the sharp shard key for the northern shield door; holding it does not prove entry.

contacts.name: the survivor of Nital
contacts.description: Nital survivor. Ask heirloom, ring, nital or betrayal about the family heirloom from the demonic pit.

contacts.name: the commander of the heavens
contacts.description: Commander initially in the burning-barricade tunnel. Carries the exact head for the demonic advisor; the other commander instead supplies godly magic.

contacts.name: the large demon
contacts.description: Demonic rally point. Carries Tallin's standard, one of the collector's two distinct banners.

contacts.name: a lieutenant of the heavens
contacts.description: Heavenly rally point. Carries the council standard, different from Tallin's standard.

contacts.name: a demon swathed in flames
contacts.description: Flaming demon on the overlook trail. Its bound procedure blocks ordinary players' up command while present; this is an access hazard rather than a quest-proof gate.

contacts.name: the mature white dragon
contacts.description: Mature white dragon in the caves. Carries the burning hot temple key; the gnoll's description supplies the hiding clue.

contacts.name: the ancient black wyrm
contacts.description: Ancient black wyrm before the inner sanctum. Carries the abyssal key. The neighboring red wyrm does not supply the same key.

contacts.name: the demonic advisor of Tallin
contacts.description: Temple vault office. Ask tasks, heads, bodyguard or turncoat about three separate requests; council and chaos topics explain broader lore. Carries the chest key as well. Removing this key holder also removes a recipient until replacement.

contacts.name: Tallin, the goddess of destruction
contacts.description: Temple rift chamber. The goddess's destructive plans are world lore. No reviewed terminal assembles seven rod parts or resolves the entire battle.

contacts.name: the Queen of Chaos
contacts.description: Abyss throne. The Queen of Chaos and her followers explain the rift conflict; encountering or fighting her is not an authored delivery completion.

contacts.name: Miska, the Wolf Spider
contacts.description: Follows the Queen of Chaos and carries Disintegrator. Rod-of-seven-parts lore does not establish an active assembly quest.

contacts.name: an enormous frost giant
contacts.description: Frost giant upstairs in the ruined home. Carries the captive sack; downstairs columns are his legs. Native proof is the exact sack object.

contacts.name: the collector
contacts.description: Valley overlook beyond the flaming demon. Ask standards, hide, charm or dragon about two independent historical collections.

contacts.name: the bodyguard of Tallin
contacts.description: Holding source leads down into Mount Banishment. Carries the essence; actual wandering encounter, recovery and a resummoned bodyguard need separate evidence.

contacts.name: the fog feeding off of death
contacts.description: Outdoor dispersal source. Carries the wisp of deadly fog; when worn, its shared procedure responds to say invisible with a cooldown. This item effect is separate from quest credit.

contacts.name: the nervous advisor to the council
contacts.description: Holding source leads into Torg's council hallway. Ask component, commander or council about godly magic. Completion remains owned by Scorched Valley; the native exchange leaves him present. After discovering The Scorched Valley, open that zone's journal for this request.

contacts.name: the many-armed demon
contacts.description: Before the vault. Carries the vault key for the northern door, different from the advisor's chest key.

contacts.name: the commander of the heavens
contacts.description: Other same-named commander, initially on the village path. Carries godly magic for the council advisor, not the head for Tallin's advisor.

contacts.name: the seeker from Torg
contacts.description: Holding source leads into the Fields Between raider camp. Ask blood, vial or torg about the sample; one bottle gives four distinct colored rings. After discovering The Scorched Valley, open that zone's journal for this request.

contacts.name: the elderly wildmage
contacts.description: Wanders from an outdoor dispersal source. Ask rings or search. Four distinct colors give a necklace; the promise of further searching has no extra reviewed delivery.

contacts.name: Yeenoghu, the prince of gnolls
contacts.description: Boss dispersal source leads into the Abyss and also has holding exits. Its authored special rejects the combat event and declines periodic scheduling; restoring it is pending dispatch, safety and balance qualification. Combat is separate from delivery credit.
